superPowers.PHOENIX: Automatic revival with shield and temporary invulnerability
superPowers.BLACK_HOLE: Destroys projectiles and damages the whole screen
superPowers.REFLECTOR: Can convert enemy projectiles into player fire
superPowers.CLONE: Creates additional firing copies of the aircraft

note: Every collected stack is saved locally and remains active together in later stages. Enemy waves schedule 1000 times the base unit count, while an active-entity cap protects mobile performance.
